title: [Agent Archiving] Prevent archived custom agents from being modified
summary: Archived custom agents can now be viewed for auditing but are protected from modification across all authoring surfaces, blocking direct changes and closing persistence gaps in the agent card and instruction history.
key_points: Archived agents are read-only on the configure agent page, with Update disabled
The test agent page shows an error for archived agents instead of opening, because the same information is available elsewhere
Closes two persistence gaps: the instruction drill-down from the agent card now opens read-only, and renaming a version in instruction history is guarded
Test agent and Customize profile actions are disabled, and Set as current instructions is disabled in instruction history
Every guard depends on the archived substate and treats the agent as not archived if the lookup fails, so working agents stay unaffected
